 5 OF THE THINGS TO WATCH LIKE ‘NORTH OF NORTH’
 By Rissi JC 
 November 11, 2026 November 10, 2026 
 Updated on November 10, 2026 
 Underrated shows are some of my most favorite things to watch and then to spotlight. One of my more recent favorite discoveries is the Netflix show North of North . The show is something that probably doesn’t really have anything easy to liken to another show, so there aren’t a lot of things to watch like North of North , because, yes, it is one of the more unique concepts out there. Still, sometimes a challenge is good or it’s just fun to feature other shows that are still fun to watch.
 LIST | 12 UNIQUE MOVIES LIKE HALLMARK’S ‘A KNIGHT TO REMEMBER’ 
 This show, which has a home on Netflix in the U.S., is a kind of fish-out-of-water concept only in reverse. Instead of a newcomer arriving somewhere and trying to fit into the locals, this follows a local who, in the aftermath of leaving her marriage, is trying to not just “fit in” but find what she’s good at. The show is just fun and thoroughly entertaining with just a little romance tease on the side.
 The heroine is very plucky and determined to figure things out (despite mistake after mistake, most of which happen after only the best of intentions) so this will guide the curation of this list. The second thing guiding this list is that outsider concept. These are the things I’ll use to find titles to create this list and hopefully, though they will be different, I will find some that you can enjoy if you like that brand of comedy. So, here we go. Let’s just have fun!
 THINGS to WATCH if you LIKE NORTH of NORTH 
 CORNER GAS 
 This is a quirky but funny Canadian dramedy that follows a group of locals as they work together day after day. The show is kind of slow-moving at times, but mostly just hilarious and super fun. I enjoyed it and did binge watch it entirely a couple of years ago.
 SYNOPSIS: An ensemble comedy group gets up to a lot of nothing in the prairie town of Dog River, Saskatchewan. – via Prime Video 
 Stream, at publication, with Howdy; or check Plex or Roku.
 5 OF THE THINGS TO WATCH LIKE ‘NORTH OF NORTH’ Share on X 
 DOC MARTIN 
 A British show, this series is hilarious. I started watching it a couple years ago and binged it with pretty rapid speed. The concept is of a snotty and talented surgeon losing part of himself (which is his skill) forcing him to move to a middle of nowhere town where he now must work as a GP. The show is packed full of quirk and silly characters and is also an award-winning title that has since inspired the U.S remake Best Medicine , which I have not seen.
 SYNOPSIS: Martin Clunes (Men Behaving Badly) is brilliant in this fish-out-of-water comedy about a hotshot London surgeon forced to retrain as a GP and relocate to a sleepy Cornish village. – via Prime Video 
 Stream, at publication, with Acorn TV; or check Roku or Tubi. You can also digitally purchase on places like Prime Video
 NORTHERN EXPOSURE 
 This comedy ran for five seasons and was led by a pre- Numbers star Rob Morrow. Do viewers still enjoy this show? I have zero idea nor can I say if I’ve ever seen it. It has a high rating from users and follows a doctor who moves to a remote Alaskan town to practice medicine in order to fulfill an obligation.
 SYNOPSIS: A recently graduated New York City physician, Dr. Joel Fleischman, is sent to practice in the fictional town of Cicely, Alaska to fulfill his obligation after Alaska paid for his medical education. – via Prime Video 
 Digitally purchase this series on places like Prime Video
 UGLY BETTY 
 This is an ABC comedy that is definitely a fish-out-of-water concept. In a kind of Devil Wears Prada concept, America Ferra stars as an enthusiastic new employee of a fashion magazine where no one seems to believe she will ever do anything in her new role and job. Naturally, things don’t go as planned, but she’s a compelling and likable heroine who is worth getting to know!
 Credit: TOUCHSTONE TELEVISION / Album | Alamy 
 SYNOPSIS: Smart but wholesome Betty embraces her unique appearance and independent attitude in the cutthroat world of New York fashion. With the help of her proud yet far-from-glamorous family from Queens, Betty will continue to have big dreams and deal with any obstacle in her own unique style. – via Prime Video 
 Stream, at publication, with Hulu; or digitally purchase on places like Prime Video
 UNBREAKABLE KIMMY SCHMIDT 
 I think I only saw one or two episodes of this, but it made me laugh. It didn’t earn a lot of seasons (four I think) but had a loyal fanbase (from what I remember) and a heroine to appreciate. The concept follows a woman who doesn’t know what it’s like to live life in the world after spending over a decade living in a cult.
 Credit: UNIVERSAL TELEVISION / Album | Alamy 
 Stream, at publication, with Prime Video
